duas.title: Before Entering the Bathroom
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ
duas.latin: Allahumma inni a‘udhu bika minal-khubuthi wal-khaba’ith.
duas.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from male and female devils.

duas.title: Before Wudu
duas.note: Say before starting wudu. If possible, say it before entering the bathroom. If making wudu at a bathroom sink, keep the area clean, close the toilet lid if available, and say it quietly or in your heart.
duas.fiqhNote: Ibn Baz allowed saying it verbally in the bathroom when needed; Ibn ‘Uthaymin mentioned saying it in the heart. Bathroom wording differs among scholars.

duas.title: After Wudu
duas.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولُهُ
duas.latin: Ashhadu an la ilaha illa Allah, wa anna Muhammadan ‘abdullahi wa rasuluh.
duas.en: I testify that there is no deity worthy of worship except Allah, and that Muhammad is the servant of Allah and His Messenger.
duas.note: Say after completing wudu, preferably outside the bathroom/toilet area.

duas.title: Istighfar & Allahumma Antas-Salam
duas.arabic:
أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ
أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ
أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ

اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ، وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ، تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ
duas.latin:
Astaghfirullāh. Astaghfirullāh. Astaghfirullāh.

Allāhumma anta as-Salām, wa minka as-salām, tabārakta yā dhal-jalāli wal-ikrām.
duas.en:
I seek Allah's forgiveness. (three times)

O Allah, You are As-Salām, and from You is peace. Blessed are You, O Possessor of Majesty and Honor.

duas.title: Tawhid & Allahumma la mani‘a
duas.arabic:
لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

اللَّهُمَّ لَا مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَلَا مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ، وَلَا يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الْجَدُّ
duas.latin:
Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamd, wa huwa ʿalā kulli shay’in qadīr.

Allāhumma lā māniʿa limā aʿṭayt, wa lā muʿṭiya limā manaʿt, wa lā yanfaʿu dhal-jaddi minka al-jadd.
duas.en:
None has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone, without partner. To Him belongs the dominion, and to Him belongs all praise, and He is able over all things.

O Allah, none can withhold what You give, none can give what You withhold, and the wealth or status of the wealthy person does not benefit him against You.
duas.note: Say after the opening post-prayer dhikr.

duas.title: Sincere Tawhid Dhikr
duas.arabic:
لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ

لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَلَا نَعْبُدُ إِلَّا إِيَّاهُ، لَهُ النِّعْمَةُ، وَلَهُ الْفَضْلُ، وَلَهُ الثَّنَاءُ الْحَسَنُ

لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ، وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْكَافِرُونَ
duas.latin:
Lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā billāh.

Lā ilāha illallāh, wa lā naʿbudu illā iyyāh, lahun-niʿmah, wa lahul-faḍl, wa lahuth-thanā’ul-ḥasan.

Lā ilāha illallāh, mukhliṣīna lahud-dīn, wa law karihal-kāfirūn.
duas.en:
There is no might nor power except with Allah.

None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, and we worship none except Him. To Him belongs the blessing, to Him belongs the favor, and to Him belongs beautiful praise.

None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, making the religion sincerely for Him, even if the disbelievers dislike it.
duas.note: Say after the previous post-prayer dhikr.

duas.title: Fajr and Maghrib Tawhid Dhikr
duas.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.latin: Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamd, yuḥyī wa yumīt, wa huwa ʿalā kulli shay’in qadīr.
duas.en: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone, without partner. To Him belongs the dominion, and to Him belongs all praise. He gives life and causes death, and He is able over all things.
duas.note: Say after Fajr and Maghrib only.
duas.fiqhNote: The Fajr narration is in Jami‘ at-Tirmidhi 3474. The Maghrib narration is in Jami‘ at-Tirmidhi 3534. This dhikr is specific to Fajr and Maghrib.

duas.title: Tasbih, Tahmid, and Takbir
duas.arabic:
سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ
الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ

لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.latin:
Subḥānallāh. Alḥamdulillāh. Allāhu Akbar.

Then: Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamd, wa huwa ʿalā kulli shay’in qadīr.
duas.en:
Glory be to Allah. All praise is for Allah. Allah is greater.

Then: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone, without partner. To Him belongs the dominion, and to Him belongs all praise, and He is able over all things.
duas.note: Say one of the Sunnah count versions — the main version is shown.
duas.countNote: Subḥānallāh ×33 · Alḥamdulillāh ×33 · Allāhu Akbar ×33 — then the closing phrase once to complete 100
variations: Subḥānallāh ×25, Alḥamdulillāh ×25, Lā ilāha illallāh ×25, Allāhu Akbar ×25.

duas.title: Ayat al-Kursi
duas.arabic: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۗ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ
duas.latin: Allāhu lā ilāha illā huwa al-ḥayyul-qayyūm. Lā ta’khudhuhū sinatun wa lā nawm. Lahū mā fis-samāwāti wa mā fil-arḍ. Man dhal-ladhī yashfaʿu ʿindahū illā bi-idhnih. Yaʿlamu mā bayna aydīhim wa mā khalfahum. Wa lā yuḥīṭūna bi-shay’in min ʿilmihī illā bimā shā’. Wasiʿa kursiyyuhus-samāwāti wal-arḍ. Wa lā ya’ūduhū ḥifẓuhumā, wa huwal-ʿaliyyul-ʿaẓīm.
duas.en: Allah — there is no deity worthy of worship except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all. Neither drowsiness nor sleep overtakes Him. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is before them and what is behind them, and they encompass nothing of His knowledge except what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and preserving them does not tire Him. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.
duas.note: Recite once after every obligatory prayer.

duas.title: Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq, and An-Nas
duas.arabic:
قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ
اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ
لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ
وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ

قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ
مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
وَمِنْ شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ
وَمِنْ شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ
وَمِنْ شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ

قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ
مَلِكِ النَّاسِ
إِلَهِ النَّاسِ
مِنْ شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ
الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ
مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ
duas.latin:
Qul huwa Allāhu aḥad. Allāhuṣ-ṣamad. Lam yalid wa lam yūlad. Wa lam yakun lahū kufuwan aḥad.

Qul aʿūdhu bi-rabbil-falaq. Min sharri mā khalaq. Wa min sharri ghāsiqin idhā waqab. Wa min sharrin-naffāthāti fil-ʿuqad. Wa min sharri ḥāsidin idhā ḥasad.

Qul aʿūdhu bi-rabbin-nās. Malikin-nās. Ilāhin-nās. Min sharril-waswāsil-khannās. Alladhī yuwaswisu fī ṣudūrin-nās. Minal-jinnati wan-nās.
duas.en: Surah al-Ikhlas, Surah al-Falaq, and Surah an-Nas.
duas.note: After Dhuhr, Asr, and Isha: recite each surah once. After Fajr and Maghrib: recite each surah three times.
duas.source: Sunan Abi Dawud 1523; Sunan Abi Dawud 5082 · Hasan by al-Albani
duas.countNote: Dhuhr · Asr · Isha: once each — Fajr · Maghrib: 3× each
duas.fiqhNote: Sunan Abi Dawud 1523 reports reciting the Muʿawwidhāt after every prayer. The app shows 3× at Fajr and Maghrib because they anchor morning/evening adhkar; the count itself is based on the narration from Abdullah ibn Khubayb: recite al-Ikhlas and al-Muʿawwidhatayn when morning and evening come, three times; they suffice you against everything (Sunan Abi Dawud 5082 · Hasan by al-Albani; also reported by Jamiʿ at-Tirmidhi 3575 and Sunan an-Nasa’i 5428).

duas.title: Optional Post-Prayer Du‘as
duas.arabic:
رَبِّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ

اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي مَا قَدَّمْتُ، وَمَا أَخَّرْتُ، وَمَا أَسْرَرْتُ، وَمَا أَعْلَنْتُ، وَمَا أَسْرَفْتُ، وَمَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي، أَنْتَ الْمُقَدِّمُ، وَأَنْتَ الْمُؤَخِّرُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ

اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ، وَشُكْرِكَ، وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
duas.latin:
Rabbi qinī ʿadhābaka yawma tabʿathu ʿibādak.

Allāhummaghfir lī mā qaddamtu, wa mā akhkhartu, wa mā asrartu, wa mā aʿlantu, wa mā asraftu, wa mā anta aʿlamu bihī minnī. Antal-muqaddimu, wa antal-mu’akhkhiru, lā ilāha illā ant.

Allāhumma aʿinnī ʿalā dhikrika, wa shukrika, wa ḥusni ʿibādatik.
duas.en:
My Lord, protect me from Your punishment on the Day You resurrect Your servants.

O Allah, forgive me what I have sent ahead and what I have delayed, what I have done secretly and what I have done openly, what I have exceeded in, and what You know better than me. You are the One Who brings forward and the One Who delays. None has the right to be worshipped except You.

O Allah, help me to remember You, thank You, and worship You well.
duas.note: Optional additions beyond the core routine — beautiful to add when you have a moment.
duas.source: Sahih Muslim 709; Sahih Muslim 771; Sunan Abi Dawud 1522
